title: Limit Defender CPU usage
description: Set the maximum CPU usage for Windows Defender scans.

examples.description: Limit Defender to 25% CPU (balance between performance and scan speed)
Limit Defender to 10% CPU (very slow PC, very long scan)
Limit Defender to 50% CPU (Windows default, fast scan)
No CPU limit (fastest scan, the PC can slow down a lot)

notes: Default: 50% CPU. Recommendations: gaming or streaming PC: 10-15%, office PC: 25%, server or dedicated PC: 50-100%. The lower the limit, the longer the scans but the smoother the PC. The higher the limit, the faster the scans but the PC may slow down.

fr.title: Limiter l'utilisation CPU de Defender
fr.description: Configure la limite maximale d'utilisation CPU pour les analyses Windows Defender.
fr.notes: Par défaut: 50% CPU. Recommandations: PC gaming/streaming: 10-15%, PC bureautique: 25%, PC serveur/dédié: 50-100%. Plus la limite est basse: analyses plus longues mais PC plus fluide. Plus la limite est haute: analyses rapides mais ralentissements possibles.

examples.Set-MpPreference -ScanAvgCPULoadFactor 2: Limite Defender à 25% CPU (équilibre perf/vitesse scan)
examples.Set-MpPreference -ScanAvgCPULoadFactor 1: Limite Defender à 10% CPU (PC très lent, scan très long)
examples.Set-MpPreference -ScanAvgCPULoadFactor 5: Limite Defender à 50% CPU (défaut Windows, scan rapide)
examples.Set-MpPreference -ScanAvgCPULoadFactor 1: Pas de limite CPU (scan le plus rapide, PC peut ralentir beaucoup)

es.title: Limitar el uso de CPU de Defender
es.description: Establece el uso máximo de CPU para los análisis de Windows Defender.
